name: Latea
source:
Laitia is a female warrior serving the kingdom of Vold. She was found and raised by King Vencefield from her childhood.Laitia has pledged her total allegiance to the king. She is a cold-hearted warrior who blindly follows orders.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031206133506fw_/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/new/2001/0126_card_of_distiny/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
